events.title: The Choir of Man
events.description: A high-energy, immersive musical experience set in a pub, featuring live music, dance, and storytelling that celebrates community and friendship. It combines hit songs with tap dance and pub culture in an intimate performance setting.

events.title: Pasifika Made Cultural Workshops and Marketplace
events.description: A series of interactive workshops and a marketplace celebrating Pacific Islander artistry, crafts, and cultural practices. Participants can engage directly with artisans to learn traditional skills and explore creative techniques.
